Build-Depends: cmake, debhelper-compat (= 14), help2man <!cross>, libboost-dev, libdtk6core-dev, libglib2.0-dev, libisoburn-dev, liblucene++-dev, libmediainfo-dev, libmount-dev, libsecret-1-dev, libssl-dev, libudisks2-dev, pkgconf, qt6-base-dev
Description: file management libraries used by DDE util-dfm is a collection of Qt6 libraries used by the Deepin File Manager and other components of the Deepin Desktop Environment: . * dfm-io: file input/output abstraction layer built on top of GIO; * dfm-mount: block device and network share mounting through UDisks2; * dfm-burn: optical disc (CD/DVD/BD) burning through libisoburn; * dfm-search: file name, content and semantic search using Lucene++. . This package is part of DDE (Deepin Desktop Environment).
Package-List: deepin-util-dfm-tools deb utils optional arch=any libdfm6-1 deb libs optional arch=any libdfm6-dev deb libdevel optional arch=any
